text:
Calgary and Seattle meet for the fourth time this season, and the first three went one way: SEA lost 6-2 at CGY five days ago, after 6-1 and 1-6 results in the first week of October. The Flames won 2-1 at SJS on Sunday, with William Stromgren scoring his first NHL goal, but they're missing Connor Zary and Samuel Honzek. The Kraken have had four days off and are without Jared McCann (lower body, ESPN's estimated return Jan 2). Jordan Eberle has taken his spot beside Matty Beniers and Mackie Samoskevich, and Beniers has moved onto the first power-play unit.

Our numbers see a near coin flip, 2.96 expected goals for CGY and 3.00 for SEA tonight. At five on five, CGY has taken 46% of the chances and SEA 45%. The Flames are better than their record, with finishing and goaltending costing them. Seattle's results are ahead of its chances. Projected goalies Dustin Wolf (CGY) and Joey Daccord (SEA) are both below expected: Wolf is at -6.3 goals saved above expected this season and -2.8 last year, Daccord at -2.9 and -6.1.

Joel Farabee tops CGY's scoring chances in our model at 27% to score, and he runs the top power play. Morgan Frost, at 24%, is one point from 200 career points. For SEA, Eberle leads at 28%. Berkly Catton has nine points in ten games. Our under-the-radar pick is Ryan Strome, a third-liner whose shots have been dangerous lately (2.2 expected goals in his last 10 games), at 16% to score against a Seattle defense that gives up the 10th-most expected goals per 60.
